evidence: SW 2025 focused live tests test_move_body_translation_saves_and_closes and test_copy_body_translation_saves_and_closes: InsertMoveCopyBody2(0.03,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,copy,1) translated a 20x20x10 mm body 30 mm along X; movement preserved 4000 mm3 with one body, copy produced two bodies totaling 8000 mm3; bounding boxes, volume, saved native .SLDPRT and closure verified for both modes.

requested_behavior: Create a tangent ruled surface from a sheet edge
evidence: SW 2025 focused live test test_ruled_sheet_from_planar_edge_saves_and_closes: InsertRuledSurfaceFromEdge2 with tangent type 0 and mark 4 on a 40 mm planar sheet edge added 200 mm2 to 1600 mm2 planar surface; saved native .SLDPRT and closed scratch part.

requested_behavior: Combine two overlapping solid bodies by union, subtraction, or intersection

requested_behavior: Create an open lofted sheet from two ordered sketches
evidence: SW 2025 focused live test test_loft_surface_between_square_profiles_saves_and_closes: InsertLoftRefSurface(False,False,False) selected two 20x20 mm rectangles on parallel planes 30 mm apart (mark 1); void API produced BlendRefSurface and one sheet with 2400 mm2 lateral area and zero solid volume; saved native .SLDPRT and closed scratch part.

requested_behavior: Sweep a circle sketch along a straight path into a cylindrical sheet

requested_behavior: Fill a closed sketch boundary with a single flat surface patch
